definition: Atom-indexed starting chemical identities. Coordinates and preferred outcomes are not supplied. These identities do not enumerate the research designs or all admissible derived models. Atomic IDs are local to each object; report explicit inter-model correspondence. Multiplicities describe these supplied starting states, not an imposed ordering of alternative states.

coordination_stereochemistry.meaning: Categorical isomer identity from source; no target distances, angles or Cartesian endpoint supplied. Remaining donor pairs are cis. Preserve connectivity and trans pairing during independent embedding.
